query:
INSERT INTO entries (id, account_id, status, source, submitted_at, first_submitted_at,
               embargo_until, analyzer_version, outcome, kind, stage, hold_until, previous_seq,
               batch_seq)
           VALUES (?, ?, 'pending', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
           RETURNING seq AS "seq!: i64"
